========================================
F-string static format text
========================================
f'{x:=a if b else c}'
f'{x if condition else y:=a if b else c}'

---

(module
  (expression_statement
    (string
      (string_start)
      (interpolation
        (identifier)
        (format_specifier))
      (string_end)))
  (expression_statement
    (string
      (string_start)
      (interpolation
        (conditional_expression
          (identifier)
          (identifier)
          (identifier))
        (format_specifier))
      (string_end))))

========================================
F-string nested format expressions
========================================
f'{x:={a if b else c}}'

---

(module
  (expression_statement
    (string
      (string_start)
      (interpolation
        (identifier)
        (format_specifier
          (format_expression
            (conditional_expression
              (identifier)
              (identifier)
              (identifier)))))
      (string_end))))

========================================
F-string genuine assignment expressions
========================================
f'{(y := x if x else 1)}'
f'{values[index := 1]:=10}'

---

(module
  (expression_statement
    (string
      (string_start)
      (interpolation
        (parenthesized_expression
          (conditional_expression
            (named_expression
              (identifier)
              (identifier))
            (identifier)
            (integer))))
      (string_end)))
  (expression_statement
    (string
      (string_start)
      (interpolation
        (subscript
          (identifier)
          (named_expression
            (identifier)
            (integer)))
        (format_specifier))
      (string_end))))

========================================
F-string nested format assignment expressions
========================================
f'{x:={(width := x if x else 1)}}'

---

(module
  (expression_statement
    (string
      (string_start)
      (interpolation
        (identifier)
        (format_specifier
          (format_expression
            (parenthesized_expression
              (conditional_expression
                (named_expression
                  (identifier)
                  (identifier))
                (identifier)
                (integer))))))
      (string_end))))
